name: Skool Community Bot
tagline: Keeps a Skool group's members, posts and open questions in view
description: Sits alongside a Skool group you administer, working through an ordinary browser session instead of an official connector. It sums up who has joined and what has been posted, drafts follow-up messages for you to look over, and gathers the questions still without an answer into a list you can work through.
author: shawnjooste
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
